label: Card above the head
description: An image or clip on a card above the speaker's eyes, slightly tilted, sized to read on a phone (at least 55% of the width for anything with text). It may cover hair and forehead down to the eyebrows, never the eyes, nose, mouth or captions. A text card is first cropped to its words (only plain margins and empty blocks go). If it still can't read there, a tall asset goes beside the face, then the card goes a little smaller over the hair on one side, and only then in a split view (the render result says so). Best for screenshots, prices, headlines.

tilt.help: degrees; stills only, clips stay level

scale.help: 1.0 = as big as fits; lower to shrink

radius.help: corner radius, fraction of frame width

in.help: clips: start this many seconds into the clip

fade.help: seconds, or [in, out]; default is a hard cut

iconic.help: true for a logo/icon (reads smaller); default: guessed (transparent background or tiny image)

minWidth.help: readable floor, fraction of frame width (default 0.55; logos 0.22)
